MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

2. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 29

3. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 8
   C. 7
   D. 24.5

4. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

5. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 38
   C. 22
   D. 88

7. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 120
   B. 23
   C. 46
   D. 30

10. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

11. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
